measurement.how: the ordinary lane at 2026-10-23T10:23:51+02:00 died with OSError ENOSPC on /tmp/ar-pytest-zlf02cwi; on this host findmnt /tmp reports fstype tmpfs (24 G, 10% used after recovery), so the fixture path that ignores TMPDIR placed the fixtures on tmpfs - the observation is this host's, not a claim about every host

statement: The test suite creates its shared temporary directory at the literal path /tmp, so a run's TMPDIR cannot redirect that directory; on the host measured here /tmp is tmpfs, and one ordinary lane there died with ENOSPC on tmpfs inode exhaustion while its own TMPDIR and XDG_CONFIG_HOME were correctly set.
